item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00323","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C17","C21","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C17","confidence":0.72,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C17 plausibly supplied the core operative template: identified departments are directed to cooperate with an outside administrative body by furnishing assistance and access to information needed for its work. The child closely adapts that machinery to V.M.I. and the Marshall Foundation, adding records-specific rules concerning reproduction, public inspection, and classified material. C21 and C20 contain related information-sharing and interagency-cooperation structures, but their language and mechanisms are less closely aligned with the child's central direction.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I therefore direct the Department of State, the Department of Defense, and the National Archives to cooperate with V.M.I. and the Foundation ... and to provide them with access to such records as they wish","parent_excerpt":"The participating departments and agencies shall afford to the Director and the staff such assistance and access to information as may be specifically requested","explanation":"Both provisions direct named participating agencies to assist a designated body and give it requested access to government information."},{"child_excerpt":"A committee composed of representatives of the White House, the Departments of State and Defense and the National Archives, has given considerable study to the procedures by which the Government can assist the Foundation","parent_excerpt":"It is the purpose of this directive to authorize and provide for the more effective planning, coordination and conduct ... [and] the coordination and evaluation of the national psychological effort","explanation":"The child uses a comparable interdepartmental-coordination framework, adapted from ongoing governmental operations to archival assistance."},{"child_excerpt":"Subject to any applicable provisions of law","parent_excerpt":"within the purposes and terms of this directive","explanation":"Both qualify the cooperation and access mandate by the governing legal framework, though this phrase alone is routine and only supports the stronger operative parallel."}]}
